dataset_name: TRUscan Cosmetics LMPC Selected Rules and Exceptions
note: Structured application dataset containing only the cosmetic LMPC rules and sector-specific requirements supplied by the user. It is not a verbatim Gazette reproduction. The five Rule 34 items are represented as cosmetic-sector requirements/exceptions to the selected LMPC checks.

rules.condition: When the selected LMPC declaration requirements apply.
rules.description: Full name and physical address details of the Manufacturer, Packer, or Importer.

rules.condition: Cosmetic is imported into India and the selected LMPC declaration requirements apply.
rules.description: Country of Origin declaration, such as 'Made in France', for imported cosmetics.

rules.condition: When the selected LMPC declaration requirements apply.
rules.description: Common or generic name identifying the cosmetic, such as Lipstick, Face Moisturizer, or Hair Oil.

rules.condition: When the selected LMPC declaration requirements apply.
rules.description: Net quantity excluding packaging, expressed in applicable standard metric units such as g, ml, or count.

rules.condition: When the selected LMPC retail declaration requirements apply.
rules.description: Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all applicable taxes.

rules.condition: Unit Sale Price requirement applies and is to be displayed adjacent to the MRP.
rules.description: Unit Sale Price per applicable single gram, millilitre, or item.

rules.condition: When the selected LMPC consumer-care declaration requirement applies.
rules.description: Consumer-care contact details including name, physical address, phone number, and email ID.

condition.requirement: Applicable to the cosmetic product under the supplied Rule 34 requirement.

exceptions.description: All chemical and natural ingredients listed in decreasing order of weight or concentration.

condition.requirement: Applicable to the cosmetic product under the supplied Rule 34 requirement.

exceptions.description: Manufacturing date and expiry date/shelf-life information as month and year.

condition.requirement: Applicable to the cosmetic product under the supplied Rule 34 requirement.

exceptions.description: Batch or Lot Code, such as Batch No. or B.No., for production traceability.

condition.requirement: Applicable according to whether the cosmetic is manufactured domestically or imported.

exceptions.description: State-approved manufacturing licence number or applicable CDSCO Import Registration Certificate (RC) number.

condition.requirement: Safety directions, precautions, or warnings are applicable to the cosmetic, especially where regulated colourants or chemical dyes are involved.

exceptions.description: Usage instructions, safety indicators, handling directions, and applicable precautions.

selection_logic.important_rule: The Rule 34 cosmetic-sector requirements supplied here are additional active requirements, not blanket exemptions from Rules 6(1)(a), 6(1)(aa), 6(1)(b), 6(1)(c), 6(1)(e), 6(1)(g), or 6(2).
